canonical.title: AI Implementation Readiness X-Ray
canonical.job: Test whether an organization can actually implement an AI use safely and operationally.
canonical.bWeb: Readiness layers reveal missing people, data, workflows, controls and evidence.

derivedRubric.positiveScoreRule: A positive score requires a specific evidence statement, one or more locatable dated reviewer-identified records, accountable ownership, defined authority, and a validation method.
derivedRubric.fullScoreRule: A score of 2 cannot coexist with an unresolved gap.
derivedRubric.inheritedRule: Builds 012, 013, and 021 each require one traceable closed assessment record with no unresolved gaps; interface checkboxes cannot substitute for those records.
derivedRubric.pilotRule: All five layers must score 2 on validated support and all boundary, exclusion, ownership, measurement, stop, incident, rollback, expiry, and approval controls must be defined.

boundary: A derived heuristic for a bounded synthetic pilot; not deployment, procurement, safety, compliance, regulatory, or legal authorization.
